mapper.select: SELECT ipb.* FROM IP_BLOCKLIST ipb LEFT JOIN IP_BLOCK_BATCH ibb ON ibb.ip_block_batch_idx = ipb.ip_block_batch_idx WHERE ipb.is_active = 1 AND (ipb.expires_at IS NULL OR ipb.expires_at > NOW()) AND (ipb.ip_block_batch_idx IS NULL OR COALESCE(ibb.is_active, 0) = 1) ORDER BY ipb.priority DESC, ipb.updated_at DESC, ipb.ip_blocklist_idx DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO IP_BLOCKLIST ( ip_address, block_target_key, blocked_at, reason, match_type, source_scope, block_category, is_active, priority, last_synced_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{ipAddress}, CONCAT('IP:', #{ipAddress}), NOW(), #{reason}, 'SINGLE_IP', 'GLOBAL', 'SPAM', TRUE, 1, NOW(), NOW() ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE reason = VALUES(reason), blocked_at = NOW(), match_type = 'SINGLE_IP', source_scope = 'GLOBAL', block_category = 'SPAM', is_active = TRUE, released_at = NULL, released_by_user_idx = NULL, expires_at = NULL, last_synced_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW()

INSERT INTO IP_BLOCKLIST ( ip_address, block_target_key, blocked_at, reason, match_type, source_scope, block_category, is_active, priority, last_synced_at, updated_at ) VALUES
(#{ip}, CONCAT('IP:', #{ip}), NOW(), #{reason}, 'SINGLE_IP', 'GLOBAL', 'SPAM', TRUE, 1, NOW(), NOW())
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE reason = VALUES(reason), blocked_at = NOW(), match_type = 'SINGLE_IP', source_scope = 'GLOBAL', block_category = 'SPAM', is_active = TRUE, released_at = NULL, released_by_user_idx = NULL, expires_at = NULL, last_synced_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW()

INSERT INTO IP_BLOCKLIST ( ip_address, block_target_key, block_request_id, source_history_block_idx, source_blocklist_idx, match_type, source_scope, block_category, user_idx, block_type, blocked_by_user_idx, blocked_at, reason, is_active, expires_at, released_at, released_by_user_idx, priority, last_synced_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{ipAddress}, #{blockTargetKey}, #{blockRequestId}, #{sourceHistoryBlockIdx}, #{sourceBlocklistIdx}, 'SINGLE_IP', 'USER_ACTION', 'MANUAL', #{userIdx}, #{blockType}, #{blockedByUserIdx}, NOW(), #{reason}, TRUE, #{expiresAt}, NULL, NULL, 1, NOW(), NOW() ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE block_request_id = VALUES(block_request_id), source_history_block_idx = VALUES(source_history_block_idx), source_blocklist_idx = VALUES(source_blocklist_idx), user_idx = VALUES(user_idx), block_type = VALUES(block_type), blocked_by_user_idx = VALUES(blocked_by_user_idx), blocked_at = NOW(), reason = VALUES(reason), is_active = TRUE, expires_at = VALUES(expires_at), released_at = NULL, released_by_user_idx = NULL, last_synced_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT NULL AS ip_blocklist_idx, h.block_idx AS source_history_block_idx, NULL AS source_blocklist_idx, h.ip_block_batch_idx, h.blocked_ip AS ip_address, h.block_request_id, CONCAT('IP:', h.blocked_ip) AS block_target_key, COALESCE(h.ip_match_type, 'SINGLE_IP') AS match_type, h.cidr_notation, h.range_start_ip, h.range_end_ip, NULL AS country_code, NULL AS asn, COALESCE(h.block_scope, 'USER_ACTION') AS source_scope, 'MANUAL' AS block_category, h.user_idx, h.block_type, h.blocked_by_user_idx, h.reason, NULL AS risk_score, 0 AS is_auto_block, NULL AS auto_block_source, NULL AS detail_message, 1 AS priority, h.is_active, h.blocked_at, h.expires_at, h.released_at, h.released_by_user_idx, h.list_synced_at AS last_synced_at, h.updated_at FROM USER_BLOCK_HISTORY h WHERE h.blocked_ip = #{ipAddress} AND h.is_active = 1 AND (h.expires_at IS NULL OR h.expires_at > NOW()) ORDER BY h.blocked_at DESC, h.block_idx DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE IP_BLOCKLIST SET is_active = FALSE, released_at = NOW(), released_by_user_idx = #{releasedByUserIdx}, last_synced_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE user_idx = #{userIdx} AND is_active = TRUE
UPDATE IP_BLOCKLIST SET is_active = FALSE, released_at = NOW(), released_by_user_idx = #{releasedByUserIdx}, last_synced_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE block_target_key = #{blockTargetKey}
